0.4.4: Trace (Live, beside Activity): Studio's logs as channels in one viewer.
New app beside Vibe's project picker: name it and say what it should be, and Studio makes an empty folder under Mefi Apps in your home folder, starts git in it.
0.4.2: Vibe mode brings conversation, task creation, live work and decisions into one focused workspace, with the full Build workspace a switch away.
Remastered node styles give all eight looks distinct shapes, motion, wires and completion effects, with clearer previews, light-theme contrast and support for reduced motion.
A test run that pauses for a few seconds is no longer killed as hung.
Studio does less work while nothing changes.
Builders get a small context file instead of the whole board.
0.4.0: Links replaces the Spotify tab in Settings › Audio.
Listen together in the Links tab.
Share what I'm playing, off by default, lets the Void Engine bot's /nowplaying show your current link, station or "Local music".
Home is glass over the live node tree.
Claude Code and Antigravity builders are no longer killed for working quietly.
Long runs no longer park the executor.
0.3.3: Owner controls for the loop guard.
Duplicate card families become one owner decision.
Repeating work is put to you once.
0.3.0: Planning and reading can each answer through their own provider, and OpenCode Zen is a route.
One navigation rail replaces three menus.
Brain maps is a proper node editor.
A model route that keeps failing is paused instead of retried every turn.
